description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Find the quality alert titled "Material Hardness Below Specification" and enter the following text in the Preventive Action field: "Implement mandatory incoming material hardness testing for all new supplier batches before acceptance. Update supplier quality agreement to require Brinell hardness certificates with every delivery. Establish automated rejection criteria in ERP for batches failing hardness threshold." Save the record.
